youtube.title: 🔥 This Tool Picks the PERFECT Local LLM for Your GPU
youtube.description:
Stop wasting time downloading LLMs that don't fit your GPU or run too slow. whichllm auto-detects your hardware (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, CPU) and ranks models by REAL benchmarks — not just parameter count.

One command: uvx whichllm@latest

It pulls live data from HuggingFace, merges 6 benchmark sources (LiveBench, Chatbot Arena, Aider coding tests, vision evals), and shows you the top models that actually run well on YOUR system. You can even simulate GPUs before buying: whichllm --gpu "RTX 5090"

Over 2,700 stars because it solves the "which model should I download?" problem developers face every single day. Built by @Andyyyy64, MIT licensed, Python — installs in seconds with uv or pip.

Repo: https://github.com/Andyyyy64/whichllm

linkedin.text:
I've wasted countless hours downloading local LLMs only to find they either don't fit my GPU or run at 2 tokens per second.

Last week I found whichllm and it completely changed how I choose models.

Instead of guessing based on parameter count, it auto-detects your exact hardware and ranks models using REAL benchmark data from 6 sources — LiveBench, Chatbot Arena ELO, Aider coding tests, vision evaluations, and more.

One command: uvx whichllm@latest

It told me that on my RTX 4090, Qwen 27B (score 92.8) is actually better than Qwen 32B (score 83.0) — even though it's smaller — because it performs better on real tests and it's a newer generation.

The parameter count heuristic would've sent me the wrong direction.

What makes this tool special:

→ Live HuggingFace data (not a static list)
→ Benchmark-aware scoring with confidence grades
→ GPU simulation before you buy hardware
→ One-command chat: whichllm run "qwen 2.5 1.5b"
→ Works with NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, CPU-only

Over 2,700 developers have starred it because it solves a real problem we all face.

If you run local LLMs, this tool will save you hours of trial and error.

GitHub: Andyyyy64/whichllm
